The '''Trandoshan blaster''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]].

==History==
[[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|Garnac's hunting guild]] used this [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. [[Garnac/Legends|He]] and his [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] installed a special device in these blasters. If a prisoner on Wasskah had possession of one of these blasters with the device, the blaster would disable itself. The [[Ohnaka Gang]] also made use of these weapons.

This weapon was also used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of Trandoshans, led by the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], used these blasters during [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Assault Team)|Han Solo's mission to Kashyyyk]].
